title: Basic Authentication
description: Build an Express API that uses HTTP Basic Authentication to protect sensitive routes.

steps.title: Public endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /public endpoint that returns a welcome message accessible without authentication.
hints: Define a simple GET route at /public
Return JSON with a message field

steps.title: Secure endpoint with 401
steps.description: Add a GET /secure endpoint that returns 401 Unauthorized when no Authorization header is present.
hints: Check for req.headers['authorization'] in the route handler
The Authorization header format is: 'Basic base64(credentials)'

steps.title: Basic auth middleware
steps.description: Implement a basic auth middleware that decodes the base64 credentials from the Authorization header and validates against admin:password.
hints: Parse the Authorization header: split on space to get 'Basic' and the encoded string
Decode the base64 string to get 'username:password'
Compare against the valid credentials: username='admin', password='password'
